description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. We are seeking a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring efficient operations, financial stability, and superior resident outcomes. Your leadership will foster a positive culture for both staff and residents, driving continuous improvement in all aspects of care delivery and regulatory adherence.This is an urgent and highly compensated position, offering a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year. If you are a seasoned LNHA looking for a challenging yet rewarding role where your expertise will be valued, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial operations, human resources, and quality assurance programs.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $115,000 - $145,000 per year, based on experience.
